title: Google Play service account (JSON key)
summary: Service account key so fastlane can upload to the Play Store automatically.
why: The `./release.sh mobile android internal` command uses this key to upload the AAB to Play Console and send the “what's new” text.
prerequisites: Google Play Console developer account (one-time 25 USD).
The app must have been created in Play Console (package name below).
The **store-accounts** record must be completed; the key is created in that account.

steps.title: Select or create a project in Google Cloud Console
steps.detail: Pick a project for the app from the project selector at the top; if there is none, create one with **New project**.

steps.title: Enable the **Google Play Android Developer API**
steps.detail: On the page that opens, click **Enable**.

steps.title: Create a service account
steps.detail: **IAM & Admin → Service Accounts → Create service account**. Name: `fastlane-release`. Click **Done** without assigning a role.

steps.title: Download the JSON key
steps.detail: Click the new account → **Keys → Add key → Create new key → JSON**. The file downloads to your computer. Also copy the service account's email address.

steps.title: Invite the service account in Play Console
steps.detail: **Users and permissions → Invite new users** → paste the service account email → add the app under **App permissions** → grant the *Release* permissions → **Invite user**.

steps.title: Drop the JSON file you downloaded below

warnings: Do not act in the wrong account: the account/team name on the page must match the one in the **store-accounts** record (RULES.md Section 12.8).
This JSON is a fully privileged key; do not share it by email/chat. When you submit it here, it is written only to this computer.
The permission can take up to 24 hours to activate; if the first upload fails, wait a bit and try again.
